category_title: Students with disabilities who do not respond to teacher questions or volunteer for individual performances
scenario_title: Off-task behavior during dyad talking activities
minimal_context: Adam is participating in a dyad talking activity with a partner in his inclusive music classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay everyone, it is time for our dyad talking activity, so please turn to your partner and discuss the music.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits quietly and looks away from his partner, not participating in the dyad talking activity.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Adam, you should be talking with your partner now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains silent and looks around the classroom, staying off-task during the activity.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think? Go ahead and share.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues to be completely off-task, not responding or engaging in the dyad talking activity at all.)
